svg.title: Texas, Florida and New York, three of the four states with the most citizens 18 and over, reported turnout below the national 65.3 percent by more than the survey’s margin of error.
svg.desc: A map of the United States with a circle on each state sized by its citizens 18 and over and shaded by the share who said they voted in November 2024. California, Texas, Florida and New York have the most citizens 18 and over; Texas at 57.9 percent, New York at 59.2 and Florida at 60.3 sit below the national 65.3 percent by more than their margins of error, while California’s 64.7 does not. Rates run from 52.8 percent in Arkansas to 79.5 percent in DC. Set in Inter and Inter Tight. Without both fonts installed, the labels set in another font and change width.

g.text: Share of citizens 18 and over who said they voted, percent
